title: Maxton
creator: CrossFit
description: Thirteen rounds of 8 strict pull-ups, 26 box step-ups and 21 burpees, wearing a vest, for time. Honours Navy Corpsman Maxton Soviak, 22, one of the 13 U.S. service members killed in the Kabul airport attack in 2021; the workout uses his favourite movements. Over 100 strict pull-ups and 270 burpees, so scale rounds before you scale the standard.
